spec: Checkpointed Local Log (CLL) checkpoint record -- signing body, digest, and Ed25519 signature. Rust and Python are two implementations of one spec; these vectors are the contract.
signing_key_seed_note: deterministic fixture seed (32 bytes of 0x07) -- NOT a real credential; Ed25519 signing is fully deterministic (RFC 8032), so this seed plus each case's signing_body reproduces signature_hex byte-for-byte in any conformant Ed25519 implementation.
leaf_identity_note: root/consistency_proof values reused verbatim from mmr-conformance-vectors/vectors.json's root-2-leaves, root-7-leaves, and consistency-2-to-7-leaves cases (seq range 1..7, leaf_identity seed 'asg-ledger-mmr-vector-leaf-{seq}').

cases.name: checkpoint-first-2-leaves
cases.description: First checkpoint for the log (prev_size=0, no consistency_proof).

cases.name: checkpoint-chained-2-to-7-leaves
cases.description: Second checkpoint, chained from checkpoint-first-2-leaves via an MMR consistency proof bridging size_a=3 (2 leaves) to size_b=11 (7 leaves).
